key_insight: CIDERS formulates cloud-edge LLM collaboration as personalized bilevel optimization, using consensus-corrected updates so edge models stay locally adaptive while still tracking a shared cloud knowledge base.
engineering_relevance: The method provides a practical training framework for deploying LLMs across constrained edge devices without sacrificing global consistency, which is useful for theorem proving, code, and other domain-specific assistants.
method: Split the system into a learnable backbone and a messenger for cloud-to-edge knowledge transfer.
Inject global trajectory information into each local personalization step via consensus-variate correction.
Optimize a personalized bilevel objective with theoretical convergence guarantees and an explicit personalization-versus-convergence trade-off.
evidence_signal: Experiments show CIDERS outperforms competitive baselines on compressed edge settings, with 3.1x gains on mathematical reasoning, 1.7x on code generation, and a 10% relative gain on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds extra optimization and coordination complexity, so stability and overhead on very resource-limited edge hardware may be a practical concern.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
